claims.source_quote_ar: قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: (جَزَاءً) : مَصْدَرٌ؛ أَيْ: يُجْزَوْنَ بِذَلِكَ جَزَاءً، أَوْ هُوَ مَفْعُولٌ لَهُ.
claims.claim_ar: جَزَاءً: مصدر، أو هو مفعولٌ له.
claims.claim_en: The word 'جَزَاء' is analysed as a masdar (verbal noun); alternatively it can be read as a maful lahu (مفعولٌ له) — i.e. 'they will be recompensed with that' or 'it is something they are recompensed with'.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source presents two possible analyses (masdar vs. مفعولٌ له) and vocalizes the word as 'جَزَاءً' (accusative); further verification of the case/role in context recommended.
